issue: Frequent Power Outages, Low Voltage & Burnt Transformers
external_definition: Proportion of population with access to electricity (household connection status). Custodian: World Bank / WHO.
mapping_justification: SDG 7.1.1 measures binary grid connection; GV provides qualitative operational context regarding grid reliability and load-shedding frequency experienced by connected populations.
gv_can_support: Local incident reports of power outages, qualitative accounts of supply intermittency.
gv_cannot_support: Proportion of population with electrical connection, district electrification rate, official meter counts.

issue: Aadhaar, Voter ID & Bank DBT Seeding Hurdles
external_definition: Proportion of population covered by social protection floors/systems. Custodian: ILO.
mapping_justification: SDG 1.3.1 measures nominal social protection floor coverage; GV captures mandatory digital identity barriers and administrative friction preventing vulnerable citizens from accessing transfers.
gv_can_support: Citizen reports of administrative non-compliance, document linkage friction, local denial of service.
gv_cannot_support: State social protection coverage rate, UIDAI Aadhaar saturation percentage, bank DBT biometric authentication rates.

external_definition: Health worker density and distribution (physicians per 10,000 population). Custodian: WHO.
mapping_justification: SDG 3.c.1 tracks macro health worker density from administrative payrolls; GV captures localized facility-level physical absence where doctors are absent from assigned rural clinics.
gv_can_support: Eyewitness reports of doctor absence at specific PHCs on operational days.
gv_cannot_support: District health worker density per 10,000 population, formal payroll attendance records.

external_definition: Proportion of rural population who live within 2 km of an all-season road (Rural Access Index). Custodian: World Bank / UNECE.
mapping_justification: SDG 9.1.1 measures spatial proximity (2 km buffer) to all-season roads; GV captures post-construction structural degradation and premature asphalt cracking that compromise motorability.
gv_can_support: Post-commissioning road degradation reports, localized construction quality complaints.
gv_cannot_support: Spatial buffer population percentage (RAI denominator), total road network length in km.
